1. Slow Start
Exponential Growth: cwnd doubles every RTT
cwnd = cwnd + 1 MSS per ACK

2. Congestion Avoidance
Additive Increase: cwnd increases linearly
cwnd = cwnd + (1 / cwnd) per ACK
